mapper.select: WITH RankedReviews AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5 ) SELECT * FROM RankedReviews WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT s.store_id, s.owner_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.local_number, s.number1, s.number2, s.description, s.file_name, s.store_type, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avgRating,COUNT(r.review_id) AS countRating FROM stores s INNER JOIN menu m ON s.store_id = m.store_id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE m.menu_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

SELECT s.store_id, s.owner_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.local_number, s.number1, s.number2, s.description, s.file_name, s.store_type, ROUND(AVG(r.rating),2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS countRating FROM stores s INNER JOIN reviews r ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE s.store_type = #{keyword} GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id
select menu_name, price, description, file_name from menu where store_id=#{storeId} order by display_no asc
select r.*, m.login_id as writerId from reviews r inner join members m on r.member_id=m.member_id where store_id=#{storeId} order by r.created_at desc
select rating, count(rating) as countScoreRating from reviews where store_id=#{storeId} group by rating order by rating desc

SELECT ROUND(SUM(taste = 5) / COUNT(taste) * 100, 0) AS taste_percent, ROUND(SUM(mood = 5) / COUNT(mood) * 100, 0) AS mood_percent, ROUND(SUM(service = 5) / COUNT(service) * 100, 0) AS service_percent, ROUND(SUM(clean = 5) / COUNT(clean) * 100, 0) AS clean_percent FROM reviews WHERE store_id = #{storeId};
SELECT * FROM image_file WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND review_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM image_file WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND display_no = 0
select * from stores where address like concat ('%', #{address}, '%' )
